subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared inbound attachment metadata contract for agents, or keep Slack attachments represented only as placeholders plus MediaPath/MediaTypes for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable fix affects the plugin SDK and cross-channel agent context shape, so automation should not choose the permanent API unilaterally.

options.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel metadata field with provider file IDs, names, MIME types, sizes, local/download references, and downloaded status while preserving existing legacy media fields.

options.title: Document Current Contract
options.body: Keep Slack file IDs in placeholders and media references only, then close or defer structured metadata until a broader channel-context effort is prioritized.

options.title: Prototype Slack-Only Metadata
options.body: Add a narrow Slack field first, accepting later migration risk if sibling channels need a different shared shape.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel metadata field with provider file IDs, names, MIME types, sizes, local/download references, and downloaded status while preserving existing legacy media fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent work tie vincentkoc to the shared channel/media surface that needs the API decision.
